description: This is a Java class file defining a Spring Boot REST controller for handling account and transaction operations in a banking application. It uses Spring annotations for request mapping and dependency injection, delegating business logic to a service layer.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller handling banking account operations such as retrieving account details, creating new accounts, performing transfers, and fetching transaction history.

methods.name: getByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve account information by account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new account for a customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to perform fund transfer operations.

methods.name: getTransactionByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve transaction history for an account.
